content:
olivia_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize the operational entry criteria for GA (targeting next quarter). Main buckets: SLA %, docs checklist, support/oncall, monitoring/alerts, pricing guardrails. What's currently blocking?

ashish_eng: I think the big tradeoff is p99 latency vs batching for cost. If we push for p99 200ms we lose a lot of batching efficiency.

eva_doc: Docs checklist draft is near ready. Missing callouts for SLA scope (dedicated vs hosted differences) and RBAC/KMS config examples.

maria_support: Support readiness — need oncall runbook, escalation matrix, and a routing policy for Dedicated customers. Also training for L2.

kevin_finops: Pricing guardrail question: do we require a documented overage policy + burst pricing? Customers keep asking about committed vs burst pricing.

olivia_pm: Good. Let's enumerate concrete acceptance criteria so we can close this week. Proposal:
- SLA: uptime commitment + credits formula, and p99 latency target per route.
- Docs: public GA guide + internal playbook + quickstart examples.
- Support: oncall rota + L2 playbook + SLO for first response times.
- Monitoring: alerts + dashboards + synthetic checks.
- Pricing: published tiers + overage rules + escalation to sales for exceptions.

ashish_eng: Suggested SLA specifics: uptime 99.95%, p99 latency 200ms for small models (<2k tokens) on Hosted; Dedicated to be "best-effort" with explicit commit in contract. Exceptions allowed for encrypted/private infra.

kevin_finops: 99.95% is fine but call out cost impact in docs and the credit calc. I'll draft the math: credits = min(1, downtime_minutes / 60) * monthly_commit_percent.

nate_oncall: Oncall notes: rotation 1 week, primary + secondary. Pager thresholds:
- P0: total cluster outage (pager immediately)
- P1: p99 latency > 2x baseline for >5m (pager)
- P2: error rate spike > 3% for 10m (Slack alert)

maria_support: L2 playbook needs a runbook snippet showing steps to triage throttling vs model degradation vs infra. I'll add templates.

olivia_pm: EVA — we need examples in docs showing how customers can pin model versions and fallback policies. Also include a short snippet for on-prem KMS config.

eva_doc: Will add. Draft snippet:```yaml
kms:
  provider: aws-kms
  key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd
  region: us-west-2
```
Add a note about secrets rotation and audit log links.

deploy-bot: Deployment check: canary % 5 -> 20; smoke tests pass -> 12 failed checks.

ashish_eng: Re: monitoring — need synthetic end-to-end checks hitting streaming and non-streaming paths. Also KV cache hit metrics and prefix cache effectiveness. Those affect latency SLOs.

olivia_pm: Acceptable. Let's capture owners + deadlines:
- SLA doc + credit formula: kevin_finops, due in 3 business days.
- Public GA guide: eva_doc, due EOD Thursday.
- Internal runbook + oncall rota: maria_support + nate_oncall, due in 5 days.
- Monitoring dashboards & synthetic checks: ashish_eng, due in 4 days.
- Pricing fenceposts + overage policy: kevin_finops + sales, due in 4 days.

kevin_finops: I'll work with sales and post the draft to the pricing doc. Will include a worked example for a 50k token/day customer.

maria_support: I'll pair with eva_doc for the L2 playbook so external docs don't leak internal steps.

olivia_pm: A few open decisions we need to make this week:
1) SLA scope: include Dedicated in SLA or make SLA for Hosted only and add contract-level commitments for Dedicated?
2) Latency target: strict p99 200ms vs more lenient 250ms to preserve batching.
3) Pricing: publish burst rates or require sales negotiation for bursts >40% of commit?

ashish_eng: My vote: Hosted SLA only (Dedicated negotiable). Latency target at 250ms to avoid large drop in throughput.

kevin_finops: Agrees to Hosted-only SLA. For pricing, publish burst tiers up to 40% at fixed premium; above that, case-by-case.

nate_oncall: From an ops perspective, distinguishing Dedicated in SLA reduces false positives for oncall — better to keep it contractual.

olivia_pm: OK consensus: Hosted SLA (99.95% uptime, p99 250ms), Dedicated handled in contracts. Pricing: publish burst tiers (0-40% at X rate), escalations >40% to sales/finops. Docs + runbooks + monitoring tracked by owners above.

olivia_pm: Final ask — please add comments/objections in this thread by EOD. If no objections, I'll move these into the GA checklist/shiproom handoff. :thumbsup:

ashish_eng: Ack, will update monitoring tasks.

eva_doc: Adding doc items now.

maria_support: I'll draft the oncall rota and L2 playbook, pairing w/ EVA.

kevin_finops: Posting SLA credit calc later today.

nate_oncall: Will create pager rules PR.

olivia_pm: Thanks team — I'll convert to checklist and assign owners in the GA board.
